title: Failed backup jobs
description: Return backup jobs with status = failed. Return exactly three columns: database_name, job_id, error_code. Sort by database_name ASC, then job_id DESC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, job_id, error_code
FROM backup_jobs
hints: Match the failed status exactly; exclude all other states.
Within each database, the secondary ordering is job_id descending.
solution_explanation: This checks basic filtering by a DBA job state and a compound ORDER BY.
